title: Channelizer
text: Polyphase filter bank and fast Fourier transform, 3 inputs, 4 outputs, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding method used for internal fixed-point calculations; {Filter coefficients} sets the polyphase filter coefficients, {Filter structure} sets the hDL filter architecture Direct form, {Number of frequency bands (FFT length)}, {Complex multiplication} sets the hDL implementation of complex multipliers Use 4 multipliers, {Output vector size} sets the size of output data Same as number of frequency, {Divide butterfly outputs by two} sets the fFT scaling, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow handling for internal fixed-point, {Coefficients} sets the data type of the filter coefficients, {Filter output} sets the data type of the output of the polyphase filter, {Enable reset input port} sets the optional reset signal, {Enable start output port} sets the optional control signal indicating start and {Enable end output port} sets the optional control signal indicating end. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Input data scalar or column vector of real or complex values

ports.name: start
ports.summary: Indicates first valid cycle of output frame scalar

ports.name: end
ports.summary: Indicates last valid cycle of output frame scalar

params.name: Filter coefficients
params.values: Polyphase filter coefficients [ -0.032, 0.121, 0.318, 0.482, 0.546, 0.482, 0.318, 0.121, -0.032 ] (default) | vector of real or complex numeric values

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: HDL filter architecture Direct form transposed (default) | Direct form systolic

params.name: Number of frequency bands (FFT length)
params.values: FFT length 8 (default) | integer power of two

params.name: Complex multiplication
params.values: HDL implementation of complex multipliers Use 4 multipliers and 2 adders (default) | Use 3 multipliers and 5 adders

params.name: Output vector size
params.values: Size of output data Same as number of frequency bands (default) | Same as input size

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding method used for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow handling for internal fixed-point calculations off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Data type of the filter coefficients Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | data type expression

params.name: Filter output
params.values: Data type of the output of the polyphase filter Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | Inherit: via internal rule | data type expression

params.name: Enable start output port
params.values: Optional control signal indicating start of data off (default) | on

params.name: Enable end output port
params.values: Optional control signal indicating end of data off (default) | on
